title: ExtraRecipe
description: Brings recipes for things that normally don't have recipes!
body:
There's some blocks that don't have recipes... So we made them have recipes!

# INFORMATION
ExtraRecipe brings crafting recipes for items like spawn eggs!

## HOW IT WORKS
Recipes for tools are the same, and spawn eggs are just 4 white wool in a + shape with the item that mob drops in the middle of the grid.

## WHAT WE MADE
Recipes for netherite items, spawn eggs, horse armor and more!

## HOW TO INSTALL/DOWNLOAD
Use a client that lets you use Fabric loader. Lunar Client or Feather Client being a good option. Select the version 1.21.8. After you have your fabric loader all setup and ready, download the latest version of the mod (recommended for the best experience), put it in your mods folder, launch the game (if already launched, close and reopen), then it should be good to go!

## BUG REPORT/SUPPORT
We have a Discord server for you to get help, report bugs, suggest mods, and suggest things to be added into mods. You can join it [here](https://www.discord.com/invite/6m8gw3KQQM).
